items.title: Whose name is on this column?

steps.text: Sun disk: Re. A god’s name, so it comes first.
Canine head on a staff: user, “strong”.
Seated goddess with a feather: Maat. She holds an ankh.
Adze: setep, “chosen”, with water (n) below it.
Sun disk again: Re. Setep-en-Re, “chosen of Re”.

items.answer: Usermaatre-setepenre: “Strong is the Maat of Re, chosen of Re”. This is the throne name of Ramesses II.

items.title: Find three things in scene B92

steps.text: The ankh in Sety’s hand: life. Holding it marks him as divine.
The vulture over Ramesses: a goddess protecting the king.
Sun disk, Maat and game board: Menmaatre, Sety I’s throne name.

items.answer: Ramesses II purifies the statue of his father, Sety I, who is already a god.
